posts.text: Posting here from my portfolio specific thread to reach out to veterans here and understand how they are thinking about Heritage. Came across an interesting article today which said that milk prices in Mumbai have increased by Rs 9 per litre due to increase in cattle fodder prices. If we’re to assume that milk prices are to remain elevated this year - heritage foods seems like a good way to play it. 1. Below chart shows prices of heritage foods in orange and milk prices in white. Notice that whenever milk prices bottom out, the share prices of heritage foods starts moving up as well. image 130…
